title: Exile on Main St.
studio_context: The basement of Villa Nellcôte, France, on the Rolling Stones Mobile (1971); finished at Sunset Sound, Los Angeles.

drum_performances.name: Charlie Watts
drum_performances.why_it_matters: Tumbling Dice: a lazy straight-eighth drag, the band dropping out at each chorus; his only Stones track with a second drum part overdubbed on his own, and its coda Jimmy Miller's.

notable_moments.description: Watts overdubbed a second drum track over his first, the only Stones song where he did; Jimmy Miller drums on the coda because Watts had trouble with it.

evidence.note: Dates, studios and personnel as commonly documented; the drums from the transcription and the record.
